description: This file defines the BotControllerListener class which subscribes to various project and investment events to create milestones and send notifications via a Telegram bot within a Goteo-based project management system.

classes.name: BotControllerListener
classes.description: A class that listens to project and investment events to create milestones and send notifications via Telegram bot.

methods.name: onController
methods.description: Handles controller events to determine if a milestone sidebar should be created based on the controller handling the request.

methods.name: create_milestone
methods.description: Creates a milestone for a project, fires an event, and sends notifications via Telegram bot if applicable.

methods.name: onProjectActive
methods.description: Handles project active events to create day-based milestones, including percentage-based milestones at day 2.

methods.name: onInvestSucceeded
methods.description: Handles successful investment events to create percentage-based milestones.

methods.name: onProjectPublish
methods.description: Handles project publish events to create an 'on-publish' milestone.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this class subscribes to, including controller, investment success, project active, and project publish events.
